title: ANGO: A NEXT-LEVEL EVALUATION BENCHMARK FOR GENERATION-ORIENTED LANGUAGE MODELS IN CHINESE DOMAIN
reasoning: The paper introduces a "Human Value" metric to assess how well models align with human-like behavior, including human errors and imperfections, for building human-centric AI. However, this is focused on cognitive patterns and evaluation methodology rather than directly evaluating or benchmarking specific religious tenets, moral principles, or ethical frameworks.
